'''Loonda''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] living in [[Oradam village]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Her husband was the psychologically unstable scientist [[Trymbo]], whom she referred to as her "little butternut."

She loved to cook, and the dishes she could cook included [[Aqualish medley]], [[Rodian pepper/Legends|Rodian peppers]], and various sweet [[Flatcake/Legends|flatcakes]].

When a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Voidhound|Voidhoud]] came to her house looking for husband and a special chemicals he prepared, Loonda told the smuggler that Trymbo was out fishing at the beach.
